name: Rajshahi
registryBasis: Bangladesh DLRS provides an official map-search portal for survey plots and records, with division, district, survey, upazila/thana, mouza, sheet, and dag selectors. Its Rajshahi Zonal Settlement Office page lists Rajshahi among the districts under that office. This establishes local cadastral-record/lookup infrastructure, but the interface also surfaces khatiyan/owner fields and no anonymous full-polygon schema was verified, so no plot-specific request was made.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: No anonymous full-polygon geometry response was verified at the supplied WUP locator. Bonn's documented official WFS could not be queried from this environment; other portals did not publish a reviewed safe vector schema.
scopeLimits: The WUP locator is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity. DLRS officially offers survey-map search with division/district/survey/upazila/mouza/sheet/dag selection and lists Rajshahi within the Rajshahi zonal office jurisdiction. The interface includes khatiyan and owner-name sections; no plot-specific lookup or geometry request was made. Public anonymous full polygon schema, CRS and exact-point coverage remain unverified. No sample retained and no owner/address or identity data queried.
